_comment: Activities the avatar can do. Each activity has options; every name is a key of translations/strings.csv; each option has a duration in avatar hours (or "slider" for sleep; with "minutes_slider": true on the activity the player chooses the minutes and this is where the slider starts), mety (youth MET: energy per avatar hour = BMR / 24 x mety, Milestone 10), effects per avatar hour on GameState values (none for now), activity_intensity ("moderate_vigorous" counts toward the 60 minutes), a background colour and an animation name. An option with "minigame" is played by the player (Milestone 12). Effects only count for the time actually done; energy is counted every 5-minute step (Simulation). Options marked "placeholder": true use temporary numbers; mety and activity_intensity have their own status and owner.

sleep.name: ACTIVITY_SLEEP

mety.comment: Youth MET while asleep (v1 Step 3). Energy per avatar hour = BMR / 24 x METy.

sleep.comment: Duration comes from the sleep slider (config.json: sleep_activity), at most Clock.max_sleep_hours(). When any sleep ends a new avatar day starts: its hours change the sleep debt and the Sleep measure (config.json: sleep; v1 Step 9).

cardio.name: ACTIVITY_CARDIO

activity_intensity.comment: Until the MET values from the Youth Compendium are in.

cardio.comment: Cardio spends more energy than muscle strength. Fitness and strength are trained every step (config.json: train; v1 Step 6).

strength.name: ACTIVITY_STRENGTH

mety.comment: Strength or calisthenics, Youth Compendium (v1 Step 3).

activity_intensity.comment: Until the MET values from the Youth Compendium are in.

strength.comment: Strength is trained every step; a session that starts below 60% recovery is too soon (config.json: train; v1 Step 6).

eat.name: ACTIVITY_EAT
eat._comment: Milestone 10, Task 3. The food values of each option are in data/foods.json (same id). A meal takes avatar time (decision 2, user, 25 Oct 2026; the duration is a placeholder); its kcal and its effect on hunger count when it ends, in proportion to the time eaten (Stop = part of a meal).

mety.comment: Eating while sitting. Not in v1.
Eating while sitting. Not in v1.

entertainment.name: ACTIVITY_ENTERTAINMENT
entertainment._comment: Decision 4 (user, 25 Oct 2026): Screens and Football (v1 uses both). Football is active play: it counts as moderate-to-vigorous activity and, in v1, with cardio for fitness.

mety.comment: Youth Compendium: soccer 8.1 at 10 to 12 years; play with friends set lower (v1 Step 3).

activity_intensity.comment: Whether active entertainment counts toward the 60 minutes is still open (CLAUDE.md); v1 counts football with cardio.
